param_prefix.title: Parameter prefix
param_prefix.description: Prepended to every parameter name (for example cfg_ → ?cfg_color=red). Empty: the group keys themselves.

param_names.title: Parameter names per group
param_names.description: Entries "<group key>=<parameter name>", for example "storage=gb". Groups not listed use their key.

omit_defaults.title: Leave defaults out of the URL

history.title: Browser history
history.description: replace: the URL follows the selection without new history entries; push: every change is a history entry.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.description: base: the canonical URL drops the selection (one indexable page per configurator); selection: it keeps the configurator parameters in canonical order and drops every other parameter.
